key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, Commissioner's powers, administrative fines and appeals
research_exemption: Archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics: GDPR arts. 15-16, 18 and 21 rights do not apply where they would seriously impair the purpose, with safeguards (pseudonymisation, minimisation)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; no specific genetic rule found; health data for insurance under S.L. 586.10 (art. 9(2)(g) substantial public interest) (unconfirmed)
notes: Act XX of 2018; repealed Cap. 440; Law Enforcement Directive transposed by S.L. 586.08
